title: Diagram mode
summary: Technical contracts for Maru's diagram mode: document schema v8, storage paths, Tauri commands, codec fidelity classes, and the managed report-link block format.
scope: v7 to v8 migration and backup
notes: No frontmatter, no adr/prd/spec path or filename convention. Competing signals: prose-heavy feature documentation (DOC) vs. contract-level detail (SPEC). SPEC dominates - explicit data model (v:8 envelope), storage path contracts, backend command surface, extension whitelist and traversal-safety constraints, a versioned managed-block protocol with a literal schema example, and declared codec fidelity tiers (lossless/structural/visual). No decision/consequences narrative (not ADR); no user stories or acceptance criteria (not PRD). cross_refs left empty: the doc mentions source and test paths (src-tauri/src/diagram/mod.rs, src/lib/diagram/codecs.ts, src/lib/diagram/reportLink.ts, e2e/diagram.spec.ts) but no other documents. Filename hash suffix is a path-derived hex tag, not SHA-256 (no shell available to this classifier).
